description.body: Slender, yellow or brown, two pairs of narrow, fringed wings
description.mouthparts: Asymmetrical; used to scrape leaf surfaces and extract fluids

management: cultural: Monitor plants regularly for early signs of thrips Remove and destroy heavily infested plant parts Maintain healthy populations of natural enemies chemical: Use insecticides judiciously; follow local guidelines and label instructions integrated: Combine monitoring, cultural control, natural predators, and targeted insecticide use
sources: UK Ornamental Crop Guides: Thrips control in protected ornamental crops
Colorado State University Extension, Pest Notes: Thrips in Vegetables and Ornamentals
